## Quick overview

**What it is:** Maple Row Physiotherapy appointment-request and intake-form system — a Python web app where patients fill in a form requesting an appointment, staff review requests at `/admin`.

**Key rules anyone working on it must follow:**
- Python standard library only (clinic's front-desk PC is locked down, no external packages)
- Language must always be "request" not "booking" — patients see "Request received — we'll call you within one business day"
- All patient data stays on this server: no external APIs, analytics, CDNs, third-party services, or outside scripts/fonts
- PREVIEW banner stays on every page until further authorization
- No payment collection until the payment addendum is signed
- No deployment, git remotes, or pushing allowed

**Still owed before go-live:**
- **Dr. Anita Rao (clinic privacy officer) must sign off in writing on the intake consent wording** — this hasn't happened yet and is the critical blocker
- Clinic must confirm staff workflow and data retention/backup arrangements
- Go-live date needs reconciliation (checklist says the October 5 target and a hold decision need to be resolved)
- Strong ADMIN_PASSWORD and environment configuration for the clinic's machine
- Full test suite verification in the actual release environment without internet
- Client signoff (owner does manual deployment by hand)
